global.style_lock: Traditional Indian devotional art fused with cinematic realism; reverent, never sensational. Goddess is always the central, centered subject.
global.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, modern clothing, western religious symbols, distorted hands, extra limbs, gore, caricature, cartoonish, low resolution

mahavidyas.name: Kali
mahavidyas.archetype: Time, dissolution and liberation; the fierce truth that ends illusion and ego.

ornaments: necklace of golden skull pendants across the chest
ornate crown with a glowing silver crescent moon
appearance: Very dark, radiant obsidian skin and long unbraided black hair drifting gently.
Wearing an ornate necklace of golden skull pendants across Her chest.
Draped in a rich crimson red silk sari with pleated fabric; a front slit reveals Her knees as She stands still and sovereign.
She is barefoot, Her bare feet planted firmly and gracefully on the earth.
Reverent, sacred realism, elegant and non-graphic.
iconography.setting: Sacred nighttime cremation ground under a deep midnight sky. The ground is dark earth lightly dusted with soft sacred ash. In the deep background behind Her, a gentle sacred fire burns in the darkness.

motion.camera: Smooth, slow majestic optical zoom-out locked strictly at horizontal eye level, gradually descending to reveal a majestic full-length shot. Strictly avoid low-angle upward tilt, camera drift under chin, or nostril perspectives. The ornate crown with the glowing silver crescent moon remains centered and fully framed throughout.
motion.lighting: The sacred fire casts a soft warm amber backlight and subtle rim light along Her silhouette.
motion.atmosphere: Faint, low-lying smoke drifts across the ground with floating soft embers in the air.
motion.pacing: Slow, majestic and steady; She stands still and sovereign while the camera moves.

mahavidyas.negative_prompt: low angle shot, extreme close-up, nostril view, upward tilt, shoes, modern clothes, graphic gore, disfigured anatomy, cartoonish style

caption_hooks: Time devours everything but truth.
What if the fear you feel is the doorway?
She does not destroy you; she destroys what is false.

mahavidyas.name: Tara
mahavidyas.archetype: Compassionate guide who carries the seeker across the ocean of suffering; creative speech and protection.

ornaments: jeweled crown with Akshobhya on the head
iconography.setting: Shore of a cosmic ocean at the edge of night, a single star above.

motion.camera: Gentle crane-up over rolling waves resolving onto the goddess; slow orbit at chest height.
motion.lighting: Cool moonlit blues with a soft starlight halo; luminous highlights on water.
motion.atmosphere: Mist over dark water, floating blue lotus petals, glimmering star particles.
motion.pacing: Smooth and flowing, like a tide; calm resolution.

caption_hooks: Even the darkest sea has a guiding star.
Compassion is the fiercest form of power.
She carries you across when you cannot swim.

mahavidyas.name: Tripura Sundari
mahavidyas.archetype: Supreme beauty and bliss; the unity of consciousness and desire, the sixteen-fold perfection (Shodashi).

ornaments: red silk sari with gold border
iconography.setting: Jeweled palace garden at sunrise, seated on the lotus throne upon Shiva.

motion.camera: Slow, graceful push-in with a gentle rotating orbit; reveal of a Sri Yantra glowing beneath the throne.
motion.lighting: Warm sunrise golden hour, soft bloom and glowing rose highlights.
motion.atmosphere: Falling flower petals, shimmering gold dust, slow pulses of the Sri Yantra.
motion.pacing: Serene and expanding, building to a luminous bloom.

caption_hooks: Beauty is not decoration; it is the structure of the universe.
Desire, when purified, becomes devotion.
Meditate on the geometry that holds all worlds.

mahavidyas.name: Bhuvaneshwari
mahavidyas.archetype: Space and the nurturing mother of the universe; the expanse in which all worlds arise.

iconography.setting: Vast open sky with a rising sun, the cosmos unfolding around her.

motion.camera: Wide, slow pull-back that expands from her face to reveal galaxies and worlds around her.
motion.lighting: Soft radiant sunrise with a gentle golden halo; deep-blue cosmic backdrop.
motion.atmosphere: Drifting clouds, slow-turning star fields, rays of light fanning outward.
motion.pacing: Expansive and spacious, with long unhurried movements.

caption_hooks: You live inside her, and she lives inside you.
Space is not empty; it is held.
Make room, and the universe arrives.

mahavidyas.name: Bhairavi
mahavidyas.archetype: Inner fire, discipline and tapas; the transformative heat that burns away impurity.

iconography.setting: Ash-covered ascetic ground ringed by a sacred fire at dawn.

motion.camera: Locked, steady medium shot with a slow push-in toward her eyes; brief handheld flicker at the fire's peak.
motion.lighting: Intense orange and red firelight on her face with deep shadow behind.
motion.atmosphere: Rising sparks, heat-haze distortion, swirling smoke and ash.
motion.pacing: Rhythmic and intense, building like sustained breath practice.

caption_hooks: Discipline is a flame, not a cage.
Burn what no longer serves you.
Your tapas is your transformation.

mahavidyas.name: Chhinnamasta
mahavidyas.archetype: Radical self-sacrifice and the cycle of life, death and desire; transcendence of ego and identification with the body.

sacred_geometry: lotus with copulating couple as base
attributes: her own severed head held in hand
iconography.setting: Sacred lotus field on a luminous red sun disc; stylized and symbolic, not graphic.

motion.camera: Slow, symmetrical frontal framing with a gentle upward drift along the central axis; avoid close-ups of the wound.
motion.lighting: Saturated red-gold glow with a dramatic backlit sun disc.
motion.atmosphere: Stylized red streams rendered as flowing light ribbons and petals; swirling mist; strictly non-graphic and reverent.
motion.pacing: Measured and hypnotic, circular like a mandala.

caption_hooks: Sacrifice is the oldest form of freedom.
To give is to be whole.
She loses her head to find the truth.

mahavidyas.name: Dhumavati
mahavidyas.archetype: Emptiness, widowhood and renunciation; wisdom born from loss, the void behind appearances.

iconography.setting: A barren, windswept ruin or crossroads shrouded in smoke.

motion.camera: Slow, static wide shot with a near-imperceptible push-in; long hold on empty space.
motion.lighting: Dim, desaturated overcast light with soft grey haze and faint backlit smoke.
motion.atmosphere: Thick drifting smoke, circling crows, blowing ash, a muted color palette.
motion.pacing: Sparse, quiet and contemplative with long pauses.

caption_hooks: Not everything sacred is beautiful.
In emptiness, nothing is lost.
Loss is also a teacher.

mahavidyas.name: Bagalamukhi
mahavidyas.archetype: Stambhana, the power to silence and still; control of speech, mind and enemies within.

attributes: demon's tongue held in her hand
iconography.setting: Golden throne amid an ocean of nectar, surrounded by yellow lotuses.

motion.camera: Sudden hard stop after a smooth push-in, freeze-frame hold; symmetric, authoritative framing.
motion.lighting: Brilliant golden-yellow light with crisp highlights; high-key and commanding.
motion.atmosphere: Suspended particles that freeze mid-air, stilled water, glowing yellow flowers.
motion.pacing: Movement that abruptly halts into stillness.

caption_hooks: Silence is the sharpest power.
She stills the mind that lies to you.
Master your words before they master you.

mahavidyas.name: Matangi
mahavidyas.archetype: Inspired expression, music, art and the sacred outcaste; knowledge beyond convention.

iconography.setting: A lush emerald forest grove with a flowing river, seated on a jeweled throne.

motion.camera: Gliding lateral track with a gentle arc around her as she plays the veena; shallow depth of field.
motion.lighting: Dappled green-gold forest light with soft emerald bounce and glowing highlights.
motion.atmosphere: Visible sound ripples, fluttering parrots, drifting leaves and fireflies.
motion.pacing: Rhythmic and musical, movements syncing to an implied beat.

caption_hooks: Creativity does not ask permission.
The sacred lives outside the rules.
Your voice is a form of worship.

mahavidyas.name: Kamalatmika
mahavidyas.archetype: Abundance, prosperity and fulfillment; the completion of the path, tantric Lakshmi.

attributes: four white elephants pouring pots of nectar
iconography.setting: Seated on a full-bloom lotus in a serene lotus pond at golden hour.

motion.camera: Slow, floating crane shot rising from the pond to the goddess; soft rotating orbit as the lotus blooms.
motion.lighting: Warm golden-hour glow with pink-gold bloom and luminous water reflections.
motion.atmosphere: Shimmering water ripples, blooming lotuses, elephants gently spraying water, floating petals.
motion.pacing: Soft, flowing and celebratory with a gentle bloom at the climax.

caption_hooks: Abundance is your nature, not your reward.
She rises untouched from the mud.
The final gift of the path is fullness.
